description: Plan 9.5 acceptance (X2.4). The plant is a pure bond graph (D28): MSe(V) -> 1-junction (R=1 ohm, L=1 mH) -> MotorGY(k=0.1) -> 1-junction (J_m=5e-5, R_d=1e-4) -> TF(1)*TF(0.1) = 10:1 -> wheel 1 (J1=1e-3) -> three rod segments (C=1/150 F, R=0.02 each) with two 6.7e-5 intermediate inertias -> wheel 2 (J2=2e-3) -> load MSe(-0.5 N m at 1 s). The two FlowSensors (motor current and motor speed), the kinematic Theta integrator and the 2*pi/4096 Quantizer are the sensors; the 1 ms LQGController is the firmware (Phi 5x5, Bd, Cd, L, K, Ki, Kff written by design/design.py: LQR + integral action on [delta, w_m, w_L, z], 5-state Kalman filter with a load-torque random walk, +-24 V clamp and anti-windup). A 10 rad/s reference steps at 0.1 s. The backlash variant swaps the ideal gear for the project GearWithBacklash composite (gap 0.02 rad) and only has to complete.

checks.note: plan 9.5: the load speed is within 2 % of the 10 rad/s reference 0.5 s after the step at 0.1 s (measured 10.130, +1.30 %)
after the -0.5 N m load step at 1 s the load speed is back within 2 % by 1.3 s (measured 10.112, +1.1 %); the dip is to 9.0 rad/s at 1.05 s
still within 2 % at the end of the run (measured 10.123)
the Kalman filter's load-speed estimate tracks the reference (measured 9.9987); no load-side sensor is used

plan 9.5: RMS(w_load_hat - omega_L) over [0.5, 2] s must be below 0.2 rad/s (measured 0.181; the residual is the encoder sawtooth at the 1 ms sampling phase plus the three-segment rod's unmodelled mid inertias)
plan 9.5: |u| <= 24 V; the clamp saturates on the reference step (max 24.000 V) and never exceeds it

no solver failure, no causal conflict and no event-limit stop. W201 (IW1 and IJm in derivative causality: the ideal gear makes the two inertias one rigid body) and W205 (the dimensionless Generic bond island) are expected bond-graph causality and do not stop the run
plan 9.5: the backlash variant only has to complete without a solver failure; it runs 2 s with the 0.02 rad gap and documents the limit cycle (the load speed oscillates around 10 rad/s)
the same +-24 V clamp in the backlash variant
